scenarios.description: A legitimate organization domain with benign infrastructure, ambient DNS noise, explicit no-result provider outcomes, and no malicious association.

A malicious update-delivery domain correlated across DNS, ThreatFox, and URLhaus, with shared hosting infrastructure, benign-looking MX/NS neighbors, one provider no-result, and a researchable malware association.
A domain with repeated DNS observations of a stable host over time and a later new counterparty, surrounded by benign temporal churn.
A researchable attack-technique root that drives the coordinator research lifecycle and persists contextual research separate from Evidence.
A suspicious-looking but weakly corroborated domain whose analysis expresses bounded uncertainty instead of forcing a verdict.
